# Changelog

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask version sync` from packages/pdf/CHANGELOG.md, which Changesets writes (`pnpm changeset version`); edit the changesets, not this file. -->

lamina is versioned in lockstep (ADR 0017): every crate, `@laminapdf/wasm` and `@laminapdf/pdf` share one version, so these entries cover all of them. Nothing is published to a registry yet.

## 0.1.0-alpha.0

### Minor Changes

- First alpha, `0.1.0-alpha.0`, versioned and tagged but not published (ADR 0017). The `lamina` façade and its core crates at the same version: open, read, edit and save PDFs (incremental and full rewrites, the save planner, undo/redo), generate them (pages, vectors, colour, images, standard 14 and embedded fonts with shaping, bidi and line breaking, links, outlines, metadata, tagged PDF), and extract page text; `@laminapdf/pdf` over the base, text and extract WebAssembly modules in browsers, Node, Deno, Bun and Cloudflare Workers.

### Patch Changes

- Updated dependencies
  - @laminapdf/wasm@0.1.0-alpha.0
